request_payload.size_note: Exact serialized request-body size was not retained in the audited summary; it varied with the event ID, index, and receiver URL.

metric_definitions.cycle_mean_ingest_ms_average: Arithmetic average across all 288 cycles of each cycle's mean POST /webhooks ingest response latency.
metric_definitions.cycle_p95_ingest_ms_average: Arithmetic average across all 288 cycles of each cycle's 95th percentile POST /webhooks ingest response latency.
metric_definitions.scope_note: These metrics measure API ingest response latency only (POST /webhooks -> 202 Accepted). They do not measure end-to-end delivery percentiles to the target receiver.

provenance.raw_evidence_status: Raw cycle outputs and host sample logs are retained on the production VM at /opt/webhook-soak-runs/oracle-postfix-20260906T213502Z but are not committed to source control.

limitations: This JSON document is an audited summary of the completed 24-hour production soak run, not raw per-cycle output.

Latency values represent API burst-ingest latency (POST /webhooks response time) averaged across cycles; this summary does not supply global end-to-end delivery percentiles or p50/p99 delivery latencies.
Exact serialized request-body byte size was not retained, so no payload-size-specific performance claim is made.
Raw cycle outputs and host sample logs are retained on the production VM at /opt/webhook-soak-runs/oracle-postfix-20260906T213502Z and are not committed to the repository.
